main_text.l: cognitionis Divinæ lux major, quàm Apostolico, affulgeat. Cùm
enim doctrina Prophetarum & Apostolorum omnibus numeris per-
fecta & consummata, & ad finem usque mundi perstitura fit, ful-
gidior in terra lux revelationis Divinæ expectari non poteft; quæ
tum demum pleniori jubare radiabit, quando Deus per Spiritum S.
fideles cœlites maxima Dei notitia, amore, lœtitia, gloria insolidum
perfusurus, omnia in omnibus erit, 1. Cor. 15:28. LXXXII.

page.notes: The centred title block is set in large roman capitals; "LXXXII." is the printed tail of the running paragraph. The fleuron row is ornament, not text. Faint show-through of the reverse page is ignored. Possible doubtful readings: "Remonstrantium" and "Synonymæ" are clear; the catchword "etiam" is printed at the right foot, not part of the body.
